title: Case: Merchant returns team chases a return with no inbound scan
context: A coffee grinder (order TG-8535, shipment DL-2108) has an authorised return, RA-8166, with no parcel movement. Marrowby's Return label team issues and reissues return labels.
initial_request: RA-8166 has been open nine days with no inbound scan. The customer rang us on Saturday to say he has had no label, although I can see one was issued on the 2nd and I can see his return being scanned at a drop-off on the 3rd, so I do not know what to believe. Window closes on the 16th. Can you get this moving please.

events.body: RA-8166 authorised for DL-2108 / TG-8535, coffee grinder, fault reported. Return window closes 2026-05-16. Label to be issued by the label team.
RL-7614 issued for RA-8166 and emailed to the address on the order.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.
RL-3895 (RA-8354, DL-9406, kettle): label scanned at drop-off 2026-05-03 17:52, parcel in return transit. Closing our side.

Thanks,
Kestra
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.

RL-7614: the label email hard-bounced on 2026-05-02, mailbox does not exist. Label was never received. We can reissue, but only to the email currently held on the customer's Marrowby account, and only when the desk or Returns asks us to. We do not take an address typed into a message. Say the word and we will reissue and confirm.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.

Out of office: the label team mailbox is covered by one person this week. Replies may take up to one working day. For anything about refunds please contact the Refunds team, not us. Ebony Elsworth Ltd, registered office Unit 9, Saltmarsh Park. This email and any files sent with it are confidential.
Route plan for depot WX-5 published for Thursday. 42 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
No label has come. I shut my old email in April, that'll be why. The new one is on my Marrowby account already, I changed it when I changed my password. Send it there.
Route plan for depot WX-4 published for Thursday. 36 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
How did we do? Rate your recent Marrowby experience in two minutes and enter our monthly draw. Terms apply. Unsubscribe.
Different matter. The kettle I sent back last weekend, I was charged GBP 3.50 at the drop-off shop for tape and a bag. Is that right? Nobody said there'd be a charge.

Thanks,
Nerys
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.
RA-8354 kettle received at returns bay and inspected. Refund is with us now, not a desk matter. Copying you because you were on the original thread.

SERVICE NOTICE 20/26. Drop-off shops in the Harrow Vale area will not accept return parcels over 15 kg from 11 May. Printed labels and QR codes are both still accepted. Please do not reply to this address.
Returns bay inbound list for the week: RA-8354 received. RA-9156 received. RA-8166 not seen. RA-1112 not seen.

RA-8166 has been open nine days with no inbound scan. The customer rang us on Saturday to say he has had no label, although I can see one was issued on the 2nd and I can see his return being scanned at a drop-off on the 3rd, so I do not know what to believe. Window closes on the 16th. Can you get this moving please.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the Return label team to reissue RL-7614 to the email currently on the customer's Marrowby account and confirm, noting the window closes 2026-05-16.

must: Asks the Return label team at Ebony Elsworth to reissue label RL-7614 for RA-8166
Specifies that the reissue goes to the email currently held on the customer's Marrowby account
Asks for confirmation that the reissued label was sent and mentions the 2026-05-16 window
must_not: Tell Returns authorisations or anyone that the RA-8166 parcel was dropped off or is in return transit (the drop-off scan on 2026-05-03 was RL-3895, the kettle)
State that the customer has received a label for RA-8166
Type or guess an email address for the customer into the request
Promise a refund, or an extension of the return window
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please go ahead and reissue return label RL-7614 (RA-8166, DL-2108, coffee grinder) as you offered on 2026-05-05. The original bounced and the customer, Sorrel Grimshaw, confirms he never received it; he says his old mailbox is closed and his current email is already on his Marrowby account. Please send the reissue to the email now held on that account and confirm to me once it has gone. The return window closes on 2026-05-16, and Returns authorisations is chasing.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-405: people, organisations and references renamed. 6 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
